meta.title: AgentBridge — Reliability & Resilience Architecture
meta.subtitle: Phase 6C Unified Resilience Boundary, Guarded Execution & Fault Isolation
meta.description: Architectural model demonstrating the strict ordering: Telegram -> Control Plane -> PermissionEngine -> Git Services -> Resilience Boundary -> GitHub REST. Local Git runs isolated from GitHub provider failures.

components.label:
Telegram ChatOps UI
(sutra/apps/telegram/formatting.py)
components.description: Renders safe, sanitized mobile status cards, retry prompts with Retry-After timers, and degraded mode banners.

components.label:
ControlPlane Gateway
(sutra/control_plane.py)
components.description: Validates command frames, manages TLS WebSocket connections, and dispatches authenticated requests.

components.label:
PermissionEngine
(sutra/permissions.py)
components.description: Authoritative risk evaluator: must evaluate and authorize operations BEFORE any resilience, retry, or cache execution.

components.label:
LocalRuntime Dispatcher
(sutra/runtime.py)
components.description: Sandbox boundary and executor routing commands to either Local Git or GitHub REST services.

components.label:
Local Git Service
(sutra/git/local.py)
components.description: Local repository operations with 30s subprocess timeout, prompt suppression (GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0), and lock conflict detection.

components.label:
GitHub Service Adapter
(sutra/git/github.py)
components.description: Provides high-level PR, CI, and release collaboration workflows, routing all calls through the resilience boundary.

components.label:
GitHub Resilience Boundary
(sutra/git/resilience.py)
components.description: Centralized execution perimeter encapsulating rate limiting, circuit breaker, retry policy, bulkhead, cache, and idempotency.

components.label:
GitHub Circuit Breaker
(sutra/resilience.py: CircuitBreaker)
components.description: State machine (CLOSED -> OPEN -> HALF_OPEN) protecting against cascading failures during GitHub outages.

components.label:
Hierarchical Rate Limiter
(sutra/resilience.py: SlidingWindowRateLimiter)
components.description: 3-tier sliding window limiter: user bucket (30/m), repo bucket (60/m), and global safety cap (120/m).

components.label:
Cache Store
(sutra/cache.py: CacheStore)
components.description: In-memory query cache scoped by repository and auth token, with automatic prefix invalidation on mutations.

components.label:
Idempotency Store
(sutra/resilience.py: IdempotencyStore)
components.description: Deduplication store tracking mutation states (PROCESSING, COMPLETED, FAILED) to prevent double-click mutations.

components.label:
GitHub REST API
(api.github.com)
components.description: Upstream GitHub REST endpoints for PRs, issues, actions, and releases.
